name: Fling with a Tiefling
source:
Tomorrow's the big day. Tomorrow is when you and your team will slay the evil entity that's posing a danger to all of Utril. With such a menacing foe lying in wait, you should be fast asleep. However, thoughts and pesky feelings keep flooding your mind, rendering you unable to sleep. Leaving your tent, you go sit by the campfire alone to stew in your thoughts.

You're then quickly joined by Karrus, a handsome Tiefling who you harbor feelings for. With this potentially being your last night with Karrus, how will you spend it?

[From [url=https://husbandogoddess.itch.io/fling-with-a-tiefling]itch.io[/url]]
